name: Four-Corner Footwork at Game Speed
setup: Four cones in a square around you, 3 metres out.
cues: Full game speed now: if it gets sloppy, drop back to the slower version.
Split step, touch a cone, recover to the middle, next cone.
Split step as the play starts: a small hop to land ready on the floor.

faults.fix: Small split step onto the floor, on the balls of the feet, before every move.

faults.fault: Crossing the feet on the recovery
faults.fix: Shuffle back with a gap between the shoes.

name: Crossover Recovery Step at Game Speed
setup: Ready stance at the middle of the space, cones marking the spots to reach.
cues: Full game speed now: if it gets sloppy, drop back to the slower version.
Reach wide with a crossover step, then push the floor away back to the middle.
Split step as the play starts: a small hop to land ready on the floor.

faults.fix: Small split step onto the floor, on the balls of the feet, before every move.

faults.fault: Crossing the feet on the recovery
faults.fix: Shuffle back with a gap between the shoes.
